solution.evacuation: Prioritize urgent evacuation from high-risk areas. Coordinate with local emergency officials for approximately 5,000 potentially affected people. Prioritize low-lying streets, drainage bottlenecks, and densely populated areas.
solution.shelter: Urgently confirm sufficient shelter capacity for up to 5,000 people, including accessible facilities and safe transport.
solution.resources: Prioritize rescue teams, safe transport, drinking water, food, first-aid supplies, and reliable emergency communications. Monitor official typhoon, rainfall, and wind advisories.
